name: Smart Girl Algebra
tagline: Math, but make it a cheer competition. Pick your level, superstar. 🦅
howToPlay: Read the silly word problem, then solve it one line at a time. Tap Check! after every line — we cheer the wins and gently roast the oops. Stuck? Grab a hint or tap Show me how. 📣
levelPickerSubtitle: Level 1 = comfy couch. Level 5 = final boss. 🔥
footerNote: ✨ No sign-up, no passwords — just you, some triangles, and glory. 💙

levels.name: Baby-Step Bootcamp
levels.tagline: One move and you're out. Easy peasy pom-pom squeezy.
levels.cheer: You dug around in your glittery cheer bag, found some cash, then Coach handed you $4 more. Now you're clutching $10. 💰
levels.question: How much money was hiding in the bag?
hints: The x wants to be ALONE. That + 4 is a clingy friend — time to say bye. 📣
Subtract 4 from BOTH sides. Fair is fair!

walkthrough.title: Meet the goal 📣
walkthrough.body: We want x by itself. Right now it's stuck with a “+ 4.”

walkthrough.title: Ghost the + 4 👻
walkthrough.body: Subtract 4 from BOTH sides so it stays balanced. The + 4 vanishes and 10 − 4 = 6.

levels.name: Two-Step Toe Touch
levels.tagline: Multiply AND add? Double trouble, you got this.
levels.cheer: Our squad sold spirit ribbons! Each ribbon is $2, and a sponsor tossed $5 in the jar to start us off. We raised $23 total. 📣
levels.question: How many ribbons did the squad sell?
hints: Kick out the lonely number first. That + 5 has GOT to go. 📣
Subtract 5 from both sides → you should get 2x = 18.
Now divide both sides by 2 to set x free! 18 ÷ 2 = 9. ✨

walkthrough.title: Read the play 📣
walkthrough.body: x is squished by a “times 2” and a “plus 5.” Peel them off one at a time.

walkthrough.title: Split it evenly ✨
walkthrough.body: x is times 2, so divide BOTH sides by 2. 18 ÷ 2 = 9.

levels.name: Both-Sides Beyoncé
levels.tagline: x is on the left AND the right. The drama.
levels.cheer: Our mascot eats 3 tacos every quarter but dropped 4 in the mud. That somehow equals 1 taco a quarter PLUS the 8 it swiped from the band. 🌮
levels.question: How many quarters (x) are we even talking about?
hints: Get all the x's on ONE side. Herd those cats. 🐈
Add 4 to both sides → 2x = 12, then divide by 2. x = 6! 🏆

walkthrough.title: Round up the x's 🐈
walkthrough.body: Subtract x from BOTH sides so every x lives on the left.

levels.name: Parenthesis Pyramid
levels.tagline: Distribute like you're handing out snacks.
levels.cheer: Coach yells: “Triple every (x minus 1) flyer!” That has to match one x plus the 7 backup cheerleaders on the bench. 📣
levels.question: How many flyers (x) does each stunt group need?
hints: First, share the 3 with EVERYONE inside the parentheses. 🍿
Get x's together, numbers together → 2x = 10 → x = 5! ✨

walkthrough.title: Distribute the 3 🍿
walkthrough.body: Multiply the 3 by each thing inside: 3·x and 3·(−1).

walkthrough.title: Free the number, then split 📣
walkthrough.body: Add 3 to both sides → 2x = 10, then divide by 2.

levels.name: Pythagoras Goes to Prom
levels.tagline: Squares, triangles, and one legendary theorem. 🏆
levels.cheer: We're hanging a giant triangular banner. Its two straight sides (the legs) are 6 ft and 8 ft. We need the slanty side — the hypotenuse — for the glitter fringe. ✨ Pythagoras says: leg² + leg² = hypotenuse².
levels.question: How long is the slanty side, x?
hints: Square the legs first: 6² means 6 × 6, and 8² means 8 × 8. 📐
What number times itself is 100? That's the square root. x = 10! 🏆

walkthrough.title: Meet Pythagoras 📐
walkthrough.body: For a right triangle, the two legs squared and added equal the hypotenuse squared: leg² + leg² = hyp².

walkthrough.title: Un-square it (square root) 🏆
walkthrough.body: x² = 100, so x is the number that times itself makes 100. That's 10. Glitter fringe secured!

verses.text: Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord…
Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit…
